confidence: low-medium. Only two usable fan votes with different audiences (Fandango = US moviegoers; Empire readers = international), 15 and 10 items long, so positions 11-20 are mostly single-source and tie-heavy. Positions 21-24 rest on one weak source (US Google Trends state-win counts from a pre-selected list) and are flagged no-data. Ranker (129K votes) and IMDb polls were unreadable (blocked), and the two sources agree strongly on Vader/Joker/Hannibal, the 2018 THR industry poll agrees with them too. Kylo Ren and Loki are Empire-reader artifacts and are the first to cut if it feels off.
